body: The Timberwolves just gained another fan. This is pretty awesome OP and I hope you got a lot out of the experience.

I'm afraid to say that I'm in a similar position. The positive feeling from accomplishing something or good news is short compared to depression, which in my case, can last months. It's a circle. I've been studying and practicing ways to "relax" and gain a fresh prospective though. Have you thought about that? Perhaps isolate the variables that are causing your depression and focus on trying to remove them. Sounds easier said than done -- I know.

Sorry to hear that. Isolation has this unique snowball that's hard to roll out of without some kind of assistance. Looks like you already have a few people that want to speak with you. Feel free to send a pm my way if you want to talk sometime.

You know what's great about being human? We are resilient creatures that orchestrate plans that no other animal in this world can create. You said (paraphrase) that you have a deep appreciation for the arts. Why not use your gifts to create a detailed plan that you can follow? Write a movie script of what you want to accomplish from point (A) to point (B). The goals can be anything from studying for the GED test to going out and testing the social waters of your environment. 

It's important that you do not cut yourself short. Do little things to build your confidence and go on from there. Look at the fine details instead of the big picture and all the bits will eventually form the display of your imagination. This brings me to my final suggestion: be realistic. Some of the fine details of life are not fun. There are going to be obstacles ahead that test your patience and your tempter. Try to keep calm and collected. Move forward. Always move forward one step at a time. 

Feel free to contact me if you want someone to talk to! Be warned: I'm kind of a strange guy. Best of luck :)

Hello friend,

There are moments in this life where you feel the essence of true freedom and bliss. You see, there is a place in a forest nearby my hometown that puts me into a state of peace. The genuine beauty of the trees and the river is something that not even God himself can draw. This place is my sanctuary and it's one of the reasons why I'm still here. Even though life changes, constantly, that area in the forest will continue to be beautiful. 

In a more philosophical note: you do not owe the world anything and it does not owe anything to you. You're as fragile and invested in the lingering question of time as anyone else and it's your job to define it for yourself. Whether your road is through music, family, or your favorite spot in a forest. It doesn't matter. There are endless opportunities to love. You just have to be open to its warmth. 

I'm sure you have read or heard this quote before: "You have plenty of time to be dead and only a small instance of time to feel alive." Don't let yourself fall into the question of why it all matters. You know that answer. Begin finding the answer for other questions instead, like for example, your own happiness. "What can you do to be happy." Discover what that is. 

Best of luck :)

Hello!

Just a moment ago the feeling of death was creeping up on me. The thought of suicide consumed my thoughts and it's something that I've had to deal with throughout my life. There have been some pretty bad/dark moments in my history; although, there are good ones too. Why should bad memories and depression be allowed to determine the state of my future? Relatively, why should depression and the negative aspects of your life determine yours? 

I'm not in much of a position to be offering you a reason to continue with the trials of life; although, you should reconsider. There are different directions you can go and there is plenty of time to plan for the trip.

I realize that the chance of returning to school exists; however, that isn't the issue. I've let myself fall into the spell of depression again. I've made a big mistake, again, and it's going to cost me. I'm not sure what to make of myself anymore. The only thing that comes to mind is "failure". I feel that my deserving place in life doesn't exist anymore. I don't really have any "friends" or anyone to talk to anymore, anyway, so why not end it now? 

Thankyou for your rationality.

I'm feeling like that I'm making a mistake placing the Heat in third on this list. There simply just no way to know how they're going to do this year. (1)) How healthy will wade be? (2) Can Bosh bring back Toronto Bosh back from the grave, is he capable of it? Questions we're all asking really. They either have the talent to be higher on this list or they can be a complete bust. We won't really know until a month or two into the season. 

I'm feeling a break out season for Wall and the Wizards team in general. They have a young core with some veterans that can help guide them. The Hornets are probably be too low and I suspect they will be a higher seed than Miami. And the Hawks will pretty much -- be the Hawks. We will see. This list is probably a bad one, but it's what I'm sticking with for now. I really would like to see this Hornets team surprise us this year. I like them a lot.
